name: nh3h2o_absorption_rectifier
title: Single-stage ammonia-water absorption cycle with rectifier
summary: Single-stage NH3H2O absorption refrigeration cycle, Herold, Radermacher and Klein Example 9.2: a rectifier purifies the generator vapour (x[9] = 0.9996) and an effectiveness solution heat exchanger preheats the rich solution; given the corner temperatures and DELTAx = 0.1, the 13 state points, the component heat rates and the COP are computed.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two capacity rates)

origin.notes: Example 9.2 of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: The native file was solved in CoolSolve and compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py --ees-units, 105 common variables): COP within 1.91e-02, temperatures within 4.67e-03, mass fractions within 3.42e-02, heat rates within 1.62e-02 except Q_dot_rect (1.59e-01, kept; small difference of large enthalpy streams). Deviations explained by the NH3H2O property backend (identical calls differ up to 2.5 % on composition); absolute h and s excluded (reference-state offsets).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the binary Ex9_2.EES inside ex9_2.eez (ees_variables.csv), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units; direct NH3H2O property calls at identical inputs quantify the backend difference
verification.notes: Compared set: 105 common variables. Excluded: h[i], s[i] (absolute NH3H2O enthalpy/entropy, different reference state in EES and CoolProp; the EES s/v records of states 2-6 and 10-14 are stale, the file computes none of them) and checkQ (balance residual: 0 W in CoolSolve; its EES record is suspect, the stored records substituted into the equation give -8.59 kW). Max kept rel diff as printed: Q_dot_rect 1.59e-01 (small difference of large enthalpy streams, backend-driven); excluding it, cp_23 3.66e-02 and x[4] 3.42e-02; COP_2 1.91e-02; Q_dot_evap 1.94e-02; P_low 1.01e-03.

related_external: EES-Community/ees-examples Case_Study ex9_1 to ex9_5 (single-stage NH3H2O absorption family, Herold chapter 9)
